title: 2020年9月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2020年9月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: 茶拥有5000年的历史。传说，神农氏(Shen Nong)喝开水时，几片野树叶子落进壶里开水顿时散发出宜人的香味。他喝了几口，觉得很提神。茶就这样发现了。自此，茶在中国开始流行。茶园遍布全国，茶商变得富有。昂贵、雅致的茶具成了地位的象征。今天，茶不仅是一种健康的饮品，而且是中国文化的一个组成部分。越来越多的国际游客一边品茶，一边了解中国文化。
reference: Tea has a history of 5,000 years. It is said that, while Shen Nong was boiling water, several wild tea leaves fell into the pot, and the water immediately gave off a pleasant fragrance. He took a few sips and found it refreshing. Tea was thus discovered. Since then, tea began to gain popularity in China. Tea plantations spread across the country, and tea merchants became wealthy. Expensive and elegant tea sets became a symbol of status. Today, tea is not only a healthy drink but also an integral part of Chinese culture. An increasing number of international tourists learn about Chinese culture while sipping tea.
